text:
emma: quick PSA while testing the new quickstart sample apps: SDKs disagree on error shapes which breaks onboarding.

leo: can you paste an example? runtime vs typed exceptions or just fields missing?

emma: python raises `RedwoodError(code="quota_exceeded", message="quota exceeded")` (class). JS surfaces `Error: Quota exceeded` but only attaches `err.code='quota_exceeded'` (no class). catch patterns differ.

maya: that explains why our Node sample logs+exits instead of retrying. our retry middleware checks `instanceof RedwoodError` in examples. :grimacing: 

sanjay: also inconsistent auth errors: python throws `AuthError` for 401/403, JS returns `UnauthorizedError` without `.retryable=false`. we should standardize `retryable` and `status` fields.

ana: I thought we had a spec: every SDK should expose `name`, `code`, `status`, `retryable`, `hint` and a language-idiomatic class when possible. is that not enforced?

ana: dug up the draft from last SDK sync: https://redwood.internal/sdks/error-contract-draft (not yet enforced).

leo: proposal: shim in JS SDK that sets `error.name='RedwoodError'` and attaches typed props so both `instanceof` and property checks work. provides backwards compatibility.

maya: yes + include canonical handling snippet in each quickstart (JS/Python/Go): inspect `err.code`, honor `err.retryable`, show `err.hint` to users, and backoff for 429s.

ci-bot: deploy-check: sample-apps tests failed due to assertion on error text (job 12489).

emma: action items: 1) finalize spec and post to sdk-specs, 2) implement JS shim, 3) update sample apps with canonical error handling, 4) add e2e for onboarding. volunteers?

ana: I'll own the spec PR + add a lint rule to assert required fields in SDK responses.

leo: I'll implement the JS shim and tests.

sanjay: I'll update Node/Python quickstarts and add auth retry guidance.

maya: small UX ask: keep `hint` short and user-facing. sample should use hint for UI, not raw message.

emma: timeline: land before next release cut (2 weeks).

leo: aiming for PR this week, assigning to myself.

ana: opening spec PR today and will ping #eng-sdks.

ci-bot: reminder: include changelog entry for error-contract changes.

maya: will add regression test asserting retry behavior for 429 and failfast for 401.

emma: noted; linking ticket INT-4872 and updating onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
